args.title: Fix CSV header parsing with quoted column names
args.body:
File: src/ingest/parser.ts

The `parseStatement` function incorrectly processes CSV headers with quoted column names by splitting them without handling quotes, leading to a mismatch in field count. Update the function to correctly parse headers when column names are quoted, so that the number of parsed headers matches the actual number of columns.

This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The `parseStatement` function does not handle quoted column names correctly, which leads to a mismatch between the number of fields and headers. A fix should ensure headers are parsed taking quotes into account.
